scope: Bounded primary-source competitive and dataset review for product ideation; no new model execution or dataset download
novelty_boundary: Few-shot adaptation, reduced channels, cross-session evaluation and corruption robustness already have publications or competitions. Differentiation is a proposed sustained, user-facing benchmark product, not a claim of scientific or market exclusivity.

candidate_tracks.name: No-command false activations
candidate_tracks.user_question: When no command is requested, does the decoder keep triggering? When a command is requested, how often and how quickly is it detected?
candidate_tracks.priority: Strongest prospective product identity; data semantics must pass a feasibility gate
metrics: False activation events per hour of explicitly labeled no-control intervals
Command event recall within a predefined response window
Detection delay including window acquisition, filtering, inference and debounce
guards: Thresholds and postprocessing set using training/validation only
Always-abstain must not win: report command recall jointly with false activation rate
Strictly chronological causal processing; no future samples or current zero-phase pilot filter
Replay of recorded data is not prospective closed-loop or free-living validation
Prompt-defined idle is not open-world unknown-state rejection

candidate_tracks.name: Calibration time and later-session reuse
candidate_tracks.user_question: How long must I calibrate, and does it still work the next time I wear the cap?
candidate_tracks.priority: Fastest extension of existing BNCI two-session assets
metrics: Per-participant distribution and prespecified usability-threshold coverage
guards: Recording wall time includes protocol gaps, not just EEG crop duration
Chronological target calibration prefixes; no test-label selection
Use actual recorded session/date information rather than inventing next-day spacing
Current BNCI data are already used for development; final claims need additional fixed evaluation data

candidate_tracks.name: Cap and computer constrained model choice
candidate_tracks.user_question: Which measured pipeline fits my electrode positions, calibration budget and computer?
candidate_tracks.priority: Practical user interface and supporting dimension for the other two tracks
metrics: Task performance at a fixed physical electrode subset
Measured end-to-end latency on named hardware
Memory footprint and calibration training time
guards: Electrode positions matter, not just channel count
Subsampling high-density public EEG is simulation, not validation of a different cap
Do not infer real device quality or population performance from one or two local users

explicit_idle_dataset_candidate.name: OpenNeuro ds005342
explicit_idle_dataset_candidate.status: Official README and metadata reachable; EEG files not downloaded, parsed or tested here
explicit_idle_dataset_candidate.useful_properties: Continuous signal matrices and explicit MotorImageryA/B, IdleStateA/B, trial phase markers and original decoder detected events
critical_limits: Experiment is visually prompted, with sitting/standing contexts; not unconstrained daily activity
Compare MI vs idle within posture/task to avoid learning posture as intention
Original decoder *_detected markers are model outputs, not ground-truth intent labels
Reconstruct phase durations and contiguous eligible exposure before reporting rates or onset delay
Pretraining overlap, actual signal availability and adapter compatibility remain unverified

other_data_cautions: PhysioNet EEGMMIDB has explicit T0 rest and larger population but is disclosed pretraining-seen for both LaBraM and EEGPT; cannot present it as clean unseen generalization.
BCI Competition IV dataset 1 has continuous idle but only a,b,f,g are human; c,d,e are synthetic, and LaBraM discloses this dataset in pretraining.
Existing BNCI2014-001 inter-trial blanks are not validated no-control ground truth.
